text: Scheduled spice under the Spices Board Act 1986 - CRES registration is mandatory to export this from India.
Indian origin carries an active EU ethylene-oxide alert history. Expect batch-level ETO-free certificates to be demanded, and elevated border sampling.

EU novel-food status not confirmed. If it has no significant EU consumption history pre-1997, sale in the EU needs authorisation first. Verify per SKU against the EU Novel Food Catalogue before pitching any EU buyer.
The premium channel for this line is effectively gated behind organic certification. Without it, expect to compete on price only.
Routinely tested for aflatoxin and pesticide MRLs at EU/US entry.
